scope: T03 changes in the working tree; parent is the only committer

reviews.finding: Unprotected initial diagnostic clock reads could prevent a successful fetch or cached fallback.
reviews.disposition: Guarded nullable monotonic reads retain stage and status while setting unavailable elapsed time to null. Original rejection, abort and successful-response behavior are preserved.
reviews.testArithmetic: 42 previous reader cases + 8 new cases = 50; two previous assertions strengthened. Red 40 passed + 10 failed = 50; green 50 passed.

reviews.finding: A later basemap tile error or selected-route timeout could overwrite a map-instance engine error and offer the wrong recovery.
reviews.disposition: Preserve the higher-severity global failure until explicit recovery; new selection/probe ownership cannot relabel it as a tile-only issue.
reviews.testArithmetic: 41 lifecycle cases + 2 new severity cases = 43; red 41 passed + 2 failed = 43; green 43 passed.

reviews.finding: Earlier manual-fallback controls disappeared on snapshot replacement, losing focus.
reviews.disposition: Raman retained the mounted manual controls, updates their value to the current snapshot, invalidates old feedback, and added explicit Hide with bounded textarea sizing and guarded focus restoration.
reviews.testEvidence: Final full isolated suite includes 37 FailureDiagnosticsControl cases, including the compact manual-state controls.
reviews.limit: Native browser focus and visual usability still require the separate browser receipt. Whole-overlay removal belongs to remaining T25 acceptance.

reviews.finding: Hidden primary geometry completion could change comparison diagnostic context and refit an unchanged displayed comparison route.
reviews.disposition: Page context depends on the displayed selection only. Diagnostic probing is separate from camera fitting; context-only changes repaint but do not refit or rewrite sources.
reviews.testEvidence: The final page regression and route-source lifecycle regressions execute in the isolated full suite.

reviews.finding: The initial browser driver did not fail on all unexpected runtime errors, lost page rejection history on reload, and allowed clipped recovery metrics.
reviews.disposition: Persistent CDP binding events survive Document changes; strict exception/error classification gates acceptance; healthy captures require visible metrics and usable search. Parent added executable classifier checks. Optional gzip404 is allowed only with same-Document plain JSON200; optional transit shard404 remains explicitly recorded as missing optional data, never represented as a successful request. Worker download uses CDP request observation plus a completed same-server503 receipt, not an invented CDP response.
reviews.reviewedOutcome: No blocker for bounded T03 acceptance: 98 checks, nine inspected screenshots with matching hashes, verified cleanup. Parent subsequently grouped score failure controls inside the existing error panel; that later refinement requires a new build/browser receipt.
reviews.limits: One postal, emulated Chrome viewports, clipboard intentionally denied, service-worker/cache bypass. No native clipboard success, upgrade, performance or physical-device claim. Comparison diagnostics are separately test-backed.

finalIndependentAcceptance.result: Accepted bounded T03 browser scope, no blocker. Final score panel contains all actions; geometry manual320 retains four metrics; five recovery captures retain four current-route features. Four Documents match build/frame/binding identities; zero unexpected errors.
finalIndependentAcceptance.hashArithmetic: 1 runner + 9 PNGs + 4 HTML files = 14 matching hashes; current and build3 page.tsx hashes match
finalIndependentAcceptance.limits: SW/cache bypass; clipboard denied; worker request+server-finish proof. No native clipboard success, performance or physical-device claim. Parent owns full6/140-source audit.

initialParentFailure.explanation: Two hook-host test setup/assertion failures: the default bus has no distinct Shortest option, and SearchFeedback child text is not rendered by the Home-only host. Corrected setup and assertions; not represented as two application fixes.

firstFullFailure.explanation: An existing score-card-copy source assertion expected the old failure sentence. It was updated to the fixed privacy-safe selection error text already asserted behaviorally by the page tests.
